name: Chang'e 4
intro: Ni hao! Yutu-2 here, and I'm going where nobody has landed: the FAR SIDE of the Moon!
From there you can never see Earth. So how do we phone home?
With Queqiao, a relay satellite parked beyond the Moon. Clever, right?
Now pick our spot inside the giant Von Kármán crater.
briefing: Queqiao is ready to pass our messages to Earth.
Choose the landing site. Daylight please, our cameras need it!
fact: Chang'e 4 made the first ever landing on the far side and even sprouted a cotton seed there.
